sources.title: Nanbeige4.3-33B: Open 33B Agent Model, 80.9 on Terminal-Bench ...
sources.snippet: Nanbeige4.3-33B is a new open-weight dense model released on October 24, 2026 under the Apache 2.0 license, built for coding and office-style agents. The model card on Hugging Face reports that it leads three comparable 30B-class models on most agentic benchmarks, including 80.9 on Terminal-Bench 2.1.

sources.title: CVLTAI/Nanbeige4.3-33B-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: What this is Nanbeige4.3-33B is a 33B-parameter agentic teacher model from Nanbeige, built for complex coding and professional cowork tasks. It is a Llama-architecture model with 52 layers, 7168 hidden size, 56 attention heads (8 KV heads), 524288 context length, and a 166912-token vocabulary.

sources.title: Nanbeige4.3-33B arrives open source and takes on Qwen3.8-27B in coding
sources.snippet: Nanbeige4.3-33B (to many simply Nanbeige 4.3 33B) is an open language model with 33.1 billion parameters, an Apache 2.0 license and a 512,000-token context window, published on October 24 on Hugging Face by the Chinese lab Nanbeige.
